title: The Hidden Stake Reveals Itself
next_chapter_hook: In Elder Zhou's voice-transmission Jade Slip, the two characters Chen Xuan rang out prominently—Chen Ji's father's name, and also the blood-soaked truth buried for eighteen years.

text.content: The night wind swept across the waning moon. The Demon Path Saintess's question was like a soft blade, precisely piercing the soft spot Chen Ji had never shown anyone. He didn't answer immediately, merely lowering his gaze to the Tianji Record Fragment in his palm. On its yellowed surface seemed to linger the bloodstains of prophets past. "Death date?" He suddenly laughed lightly, that smile carrying a chill even Ye Qing found unfamiliar. "Does the Saintess think I would want to see my own death date?" He raised his eyes, the purple-blue light in his pupils flickering幽幽 in the dark night. "What I've always seen is OTHER PEOPLE's death dates—and the final expressions on their faces before they die."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's breath caught slightly. She had seen too many so-called geniuses face death with fear, madness, or hysteria—but this man called waste, when speaking of death, sounded as if discussing today's weather. She suddenly realized this man might truly never have considered his own life or death. What he considered was how to make his own death "valuable." This understanding sent a fine layer of cold sweat down her back.

text.content: In the silence that followed, Chen Ji's Mental Sea quietly activated another hidden ability of the Tianji Record—the Breaking局的 Eye. This wasn't prophecy, but a near-instinctive insight allowing him to perceive all subtle fluctuations of Qi within a hundred zhang for the duration of one incense stick. He closed his eyes in concentration, his spiritual sense spreading outward like invisible spider silk, then suddenly opened them. "Interesting." His voice was soft, yet carried a chilling certainty that made spines tingle. "Saintess, that green-robed attendant beside you... their Qi is somewhat off."

dialogue.content: Chen Ji turned, his gaze越过 Ye Qing's shoulder, falling directly on that figure hidden in the shadows. A seemingly unremarkable green-robed servant, lowering his eyes obediently, as if merely the most ordinary servant of the Holy Sect. But Chen Ji saw it—the deeply concealed sect aura within that person's deliberately suppressed spiritual power, bearing the unique technique imprint of Tianqing Sect. His lips curved slightly, carving an ice-cold arc. "Elder Zhou's person? Or Ling Yuan's chess piece? Interesting. The waters of Tianqing Sect run deeper than I imagined."

Ye Qing turned sharply, a flash of sharpness掠过 her purple eyes. Her "Demon Path Mist" could conceal the Tianji Record's aura, yet she never expected an informant had long been planted beside her. She knew well the internal factional struggles within the Demon Path Holy Sect, but being monitored to this extent still filled her with bone-deep fury. "How did you see through it?" Her voice pressed extremely low, already carrying几分 acknowledgment. "My mist can fool even the Golden Core stage."

text.content: Chen Ji didn't answer directly, merely giving her a meaningful look. "The mist can conceal Qi, but it cannot conceal the... tension that emerges when someone tries to hide something." He lightly flicked dust from his sleeve that wasn't there, his movements nonchalant, his words like a blade. "Like now, he's very nervous. Nervous enough that even his breathing has gone ragged." He tilted his chin toward the green-robed attendant. "Saintess, want to make a bet? Within three breaths, he will find an excuse to leave—then transmit the information outward by some means."

dialogue.content: Ye Qing said nothing, merely coldly staring in that direction, as if waiting for Chen Ji's prediction to come true. One breath, two breaths—the green-robed attendant indeed moved. Pretending to adjust his storage bag at his waist, his eyes swiftly scanned his surroundings, then quietly retreated. Just as he was about to disappear into the night, Ye Qing raised her hand. A strand of purple-black spiritual power shot out like a serpent, binding the man's ankle. "Trying to run?" Her voice could freeze ice. "Why not stay and keep me company for a nice chat?"

choice.prompt: After the green-robed attendant was subdued, Chen Ji faced a choice—how to handle this insider in a way that would both alarm the enemy and follow the trail to its source?

choices.text: Fishing for Enforcement, Playing the Long Game
choices.description: Deliberately let him go, letting him actively contact his superior in fear, creating more opportunities for exposure
choices.risk_hint: Risk the other party making desperate moves

text.content: Chen Ji gently shook his head, stopping Ye Qing's further actions. "Let him go." His voice was平静得近乎冷漠, "A grasshopper can jump indicates there's a net behind it. Rather than cutting this thread now, let it drag the entire net out." He walked slowly toward the restrained insider, looking down at the panicked eyes beneath him, a hair-raising smile curling his lips. "Go back and tell your master, tonight's events—Chen Ji knows absolutely nothing."

choices.text: Strike the Mountain to Frighten the Tiger, Public Execution
choices.description: Publicly expose his identity, conduct a public trial at the Sect Competition, killing one to warn a hundred
choices.visible_cost: Alarm the snake, potentially lose hidden clues
choices.visible_reward: Deter other insiders, greatly enhance Reputation
choices.risk_hint: The mastermind behind the scenes may destroy evidence prematurely

text.content: Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, dangerous light flickering in those pupils. "Why so much trouble?" His tone was轻描淡写, yet carried a chilling certainty. "Saintess, hand the person to me. Tomorrow's Sect Competition, I want everyone to see what the rat hiding in the gutter meets its end." He crouched down, eye-level with the insider, his voice gentle yet almost cruel. "Don't worry, I won't kill you. I'll just make you wish you were dead—then, before everyone, personally name who ordered you."

The green-robed attendant scrambled away into the night, as狼狈 as a stray dog with its tail kicked. Ye Qing watched his retreating figure, killing intent churning in her eyes, but was stopped by Chen Ji's glance. She had to admit, this seemingly废物 man's judgment was correct—rather than killing a chess piece, let it find its own player. But this cold, almost merciless calculation method made her more wary of this man.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing coldly watched Chen Ji expertly set up traps, every detail精准得仿佛提前演练过千百遍. She suddenly asked: "Your understanding of Tianqing Sect runs much deeper than you show." Chen Ji's movements paused slightly, then he continued adjusting the talisman formation若无其事. "What does the Saintess want to know?" She stepped closer, her purple eyes直视 his profile. "Who exactly are you?" Chen Ji turned his head, meeting her gaze, his lips slowly rising. "Who I am doesn't matter. What matters is—the Sect Competition three days from now will be very interesting."

choice.prompt: While waiting for the insider to take the bait, Ye Qing proposed wanting to understand Chen Ji's plan more deeply. Chen Ji needed to decide how much information to reveal to this Demon Path ally.

choices.description: Reveal part of the plan in exchange for cooperative trust, but hide core trump cards and key motivations
choices.risk_hint: If seen through, will damage the trust relationship

dialogue.content: Chen Ji leaned against the tree trunk, moonlight outlining his nonchalant silhouette. "My plan is simple—let that rat think it's escaped, then watch which hole it scurries into." He paused, a flash of cunning in his eyes. "As for the Saintess, you only need to do one thing: at the right moment, have your 'Demon Path Mist' appear at the right place. The rest..." He made a sealing gesture. "On the day of the competition, you'll know naturally."

choices.text: Be Completely Honest, Form an Alliance
choices.description: Reveal part of the Tianji Record's abilities to Ye Qing, establishing a deeper trust relationship
choices.risk_hint: Once information is leaked, consequences would be disastrous

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, as if making some difficult decision. Finally, he took out the Tianji Record Fragment from his chest, slowly unfolding it before Ye Qing. On the fragment, runes flowed, faintly emanating an ancient aura that sent chills through the heart. "This is part of the Tianji Record's function—" He pointed to those vaguely visible patterns. "I can 'see' things about to happen at specific moments. But the cost is great, so I only use it when necessary." Ye Qing gazed at those mysterious runes, and for the first time saw something vulnerable in this man's eyes.

Meanwhile, in a remote corner behind the Outer Disciples' Servants' Quarters, a hunched figure was pressing a faint-glimmering voice-transmission Jade Slip to his lips with trembling hands. "Master, Zhou has urgent matters to report..." The aged voice carried unmistakable panic. "That废物, tonight had secret contact with the Demon Path Saintess, seems to be plotting something major. This subordinate also heard them mention..." His voice suddenly dropped lower. "...mentioning Chen Xuan." The Jade Slip fell silent for a moment, then a cold voice came through: "You did well. Continue watching. This one has arrangements."

dialogue.content: Before the words finished, a fierce sword Qi shot out from the shadows. Elder Zhou let out a miserable cry, the Jade Slip flying from his hand. A cold figure emerged from the darkness, moonlight illuminating her icy-cold face—Su Qingyao. She bent down to pick up the still flickering Jade Slip, a mocking arc curling at her lips: "Elder Zhou, not sleeping at this late hour, sending messages to whom?" Elder Zhou's face instantly turned ashen white, lips trembling, unable to utter a single word.

text.content: Su Qingyao pressed the Jade Slip to her forehead, her spiritual sense probing within. A moment later, her eyes widened sharply, an unbelievable shock flickering across her beautiful face—the transmission's content was far more shocking than she had anticipated. "Chen Xuan..." she murmured to herself, that was Chen Ji's father's name. Eighteen years ago, Chen Xuan was Tianqing Sect's most dazzling genius, yet fell in an "accident." At that time, Chen Ji was merely an infant in swaddling clothes. Now this long-sealed clue suddenly resurfaced, its hidden conspiracy making her spine go cold.

dialogue.content: Elder Zhou collapsed to the ground, his obese frame trembling like a sieve. "Su... Su Senior Fellow, spare my life! This old man was coerced, the people above forced me!" Su Qingyao looked down at him from above, her eyes holding no sympathy, only cold scrutiny. "Who are the people above?" Elder Zhou's gaze flickered, seemingly making a final struggle. Su Qingyao's sword unsheathed slightly, cold light flashing. Elder Zhou's soul nearly fled his body. "It's... it's Elder Ling Yuan! He had me monitor all of Chen Ji's movements!"

choice.prompt: After Su Qingyao successfully intercepted the evidence, she faced a choice: immediately inform Chen Ji, or first investigate Ling Yuan's background on her own?

choices.description: Hand all intercepted evidence and Elder Zhou's testimony to Chen Ji, letting him decide
choices.visible_cost: Expose the fact that she was secretly investigating
choices.visible_reward: Establish deeper trust, may unlock Su Qingyao's Lifebound Line
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ji may hold back due to her knowing too much

dialogue.content: Su Qingyao knocked Elder Zhou unconscious, organized the evidence, and flew alone toward Chen Ji's residence. Beneath the moonlight, her heart churned with complex emotions—shock, anger, heartache, and an indefinable sourness. That waste junior brother mocked by everyone actually carried such heavy blood debt on his shoulders. She suddenly understood why he was always so silent, why his eyes occasionally revealed a maturity beyond his years. She quickened her pace, making a decision in her heart.

choices.description: Temporarily conceal this matter, independently investigate the connection between Ling Yuan and that "accident" eighteen years ago
choices.visible_cost: Miss the best timing, may be noticed by Chen Ji for concealment
choices.visible_reward: Master more initiative, may discover larger secrets
choices.risk_hint: Solo action is dangerous, and may cause Chen Ji to distrust

text.content: Su Qingyao stored the evidence in her storage bag, but didn't immediately去找 Chen Ji. Gazing toward Ling Yuan's cave dwelling, complex light flickered in her eyes. Ling Yuan was her master-grandfather, always quite kind to her. Now he was entangled in such a blood-soaked case... She took a deep breath, forcing herself to remain calm. If she told Chen Ji now, he would certainly act rashly. Better to investigate secretly first, and once she had more solid evidence, make plans. Her fist slowly tightened in her sleeve, knuckles whitening from the force.

Just as Su Qingyao's figure vanished into the night, Chen Ji was standing atop an ancient pine not far away, his robes fluttering in the wind. He had witnessed everything—from Elder Zhou's transmission, to Su Qingyao's interception, to her final decision. He didn't intervene, didn't even let the other party know he was there. He merely quietly watched that figure hurrying through the moonlight, a hint of warmth flickering in his eyes that even he hadn't noticed. This woman, in the end, chose to stand on his side.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's voice came from behind, carrying inquiry: "You knew she would come?" Chen Ji didn't turn around, merely gazing at where Su Qingyao disappeared. "I didn't know she would come. But I knew, given the chance, she would stand on my side." His voice was soft, yet carried an unquestionable certainty. "Because she's like me—someone this sect, this Heaven and Earth, owes far too much to." Ye Qing fell silent. She suddenly realized she could see through this man less and less. His scheming's depth and reach far exceeded her imagination.

text.content: The night wind grew cold, the moon slanted westward. Chen Ji finally turned around, that rare softness on his face gone, replaced by his usual coldness and depth. He looked at Ye Qing, his voice平静得仿佛在谈论明日天气: "Saintess, if you're free three days from now at the Sect Competition, you might as well come watch." His lips curved slightly, carving a meaningful arc. "That day, perhaps many old friends will appear—and perhaps, some... unexpected guests." His words held hidden profundity, setting alarm bells ringing in Ye Qing's heart.

Meanwhile, deep within Tianqing Sect, in a cave dwelling perpetually shrouded in clouds and mist, a pair of turbid yet profound eyes slowly opened. Ling Yuan—this old Sect Master of Tianqing Sect—was listening to his subordinate report everything that happened tonight. When hearing the words "Chen Xuan," an unnoticeable tremor passed across his withered features. "Chen Ji..." he murmured, voice aged and hoarse. "Eighteen years have passed. Your father owed me. Now have you come to repay?" His lips slowly curved, revealing a smile that could freeze blood. "Unfortunately, you're not qualified enough."

Night darkness如墨, Tianqing Sect's surface平静如常, yet undercurrents surged violently. The Sect Competition three days later would definitely not be a simple match—it would be a battlefield for all factions' contention, the opening of Chen Ji's revenge chess game, and also the moment when eighteen years of Tianqing Sect's sealed secrets would be revealed. Everyone waited for that seemingly废物 Servant Disciple to appear, yet none knew that废物 had long spread an天罗地网 in the darkness, waiting for prey to fall into the trap. And at this moment, Chen Ji stood at fate's crossroads, gazing toward the direction his father once lived, flames burning silently in his eyes.
